test-set.name: switch-boundaries
test-set.description: Additional switch atomization, comparison, focus and result boundaries.

test-case.name: switch-010
test-case.description: An empty test sequence does not match and its failing result is not evaluated.

test-case.name: switch-011
test-case.description: An empty selector cannot satisfy the required single atomic item.

test-case.name: switch-012
test-case.description: Selector node atomization must still produce only one atomic item.

test-case.name: switch-013
test-case.description: A node-valued test sequence is atomized before general comparison.

test-case.name: switch-014
test-case.description: NaN does not equal NaN and the otherwise branch is selected.

test-case.name: switch-015
test-case.description: QName comparison uses expanded names rather than prefix spelling or local name alone.

test-case.name: switch-016
test-case.description: Switch collation governs branch comparison even with a different collation on when.

test-case.name: switch-017
test-case.description: Selector, test and result expressions retain the caller item, position and size.

result.assert-xml: <out><v item="10" position="1" size="2"/><after item="10" position="1" size="2"/><v item="20" position="2" size="2"/><after item="20" position="2" size="2"/></out>

test-case.name: switch-018
test-case.description: A selected node sequence retains identity and explicitly reversed order.

test-case.name: switch-019
test-case.description: A selected function item is returned without atomization and remains callable.

test-case.name: switch-020
test-case.description: An error in the selected result propagates without falling through to otherwise.

test-case.name: switch-021
test-case.description: An earlier nonmatching result is not evaluated before the selected constructor.
